features.name: Authentication
features.description: Email and password login with signed session cookies and logout.

children.name: Login
children.description: Validates credentials and starts a signed session cookie.

children.name: Logout
children.description: Clears the session cookie and redirects to the login page.

features.name: Tasks
features.description: Create, complete, and filter personal tasks with due dates.

children.name: Task list
children.description: Lists the signed-in user's tasks grouped by due date.

children.name: Task lifecycle
children.description: Create, complete, and reopen tasks with optimistic UI updates.
